reasons.theme-a: Drought worse than 2023 and paid insurance claims show demand; timing is the current dry season; government programmes (AUTP, PATS) are partners as much as competitors; pumps and rural selling cost capital; regulation is supportive.
reasons.theme-b: Diesel spike and disrupted supply chains raise demand, but the spike may reverse; consultancies and logistics software already crowd the space; a service needs little capital; low regulatory exposure.
reasons.theme-c: Rp12 trillion of scam losses and an OJK push show demand; OJK building its own app both validates and threatens; banks and telcos compete; software is capital-light; financial data and the PDP law raise regulatory risk.
